name: Sundial
description: A dial plate with the style laid across it, both turned by the cell's bearing.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 4%; border-radius: 50%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: repeating-conic-gradient(from 0deg at 50% 50%, #000 0 6deg, transparent 6deg 30deg); mask: repeating-conic-gradient(from 0deg at 50% 50%, #000 0 6deg, transparent 6deg 30deg); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 48%; top: 10%; width: 5%; height: 40%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); transform-origin: 50% 100%; -webkit-transform: rotate(@calc(@atan2(2 * @y / @Y - 1 - 1 / @Y, 2 * @x / @X - 1 - 1 / @X) * 57.2958)deg); transform: rotate(@calc(@atan2(2 * @y / @Y - 1 - 1 / @Y, 2 * @x / @X - 1 - 1 / @X) * 57.2958)deg); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
